indicators.label: Inflation (this month)
indicators.explain: How much prices rose in the latest month (consumer price index). The yearly rate can't be calculated because the government didn't publish data for the same month last year.

indicators.label: Unemployment
indicators.explain: Share of people who want a job but don't have one. Low means a strong job market.

indicators.label: Jobs added
indicators.explain: How many jobs US employers added last month (nonfarm payrolls), in thousands.

indicators.label: Fed interest rate
indicators.explain: The top of the Federal Reserve's target rate. Higher rates make borrowing costlier and can cool prices.

indicators.label: Gas price
indicators.explain: Average US price of a gallon of regular gas, weekly. A quick read on energy costs for households.
